defects.summary: With --project-from-cwd, Serena 1.7.0 activates no project in a folder without .git or .serena/project.yml, and then the read-only mode's exclusions are not applied: tools/list shows 23 tools incl. replace_symbol_body, rename_symbol, replace_in_files, write_memory (probe 2026-10-12). Agents still cannot call them (REQ-1007 grants 5 tools by name), but REQ-1006's 'exposes only the read-only tools' fails outside git. Verified fix: '--project .' (Claude Code starts MCP servers in the project folder) gives the 7 read-only tools with or without git. Proposed: replace --project-from-cwd with --project . in REQ-1006/IF-14 §4/TS-1007.
defects.resolution: REQ-1006/TS-1007/IF-14 §4 revised (G2/G3 2026-10-12); .mcp.json uses --project . (c496b49); 7 read-only tools with and without git

defects.summary: Enhancement (P-01, 2026-10-13): agents never commit, so .sdd/ history depends on the user remembering. Add an opt-in flag to sdd gate approve (e.g. --commit) that, after a successful approval, commits only the .sdd/ files of the change and the workspace status files with a message naming the change, gate and approver ('CHG-NNN: G2 (spec) approved by <name>'); refuses with a clear error outside a git repository or when other staged changes exist. Done by the deterministic CLI, so the agents' read-only git allowlist stays unchanged; the conductor passes the flag only when P-01 opted in (constitution or per-gate answer). Needs REQ/AC/TS in CAP-08, IF-01 row, gate-protocol skill and the commands.
defects.resolution: REQ-816/817 (G2/G3 2026-10-13); sdd gate approve --commit (91f7bcf)

defects.summary: Serena writes .serena/ (project.yml, cache, memories) into any repository where a session starts with the plugin enabled, until sdd serena-config has run (only /architect:init and /architect:doctor run it): observed 2026-10-12 in this repository after installing the packaged plugin. REQ-1013 assumes init/doctor run before Serena's first start, but the MCP server starts with every session, also in unrelated repositories (spirit of REQ-912). Proposed: launch Serena through the CLI (.mcp.json command node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sdd.mjs serena-launch, which writes the config into ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/serena when missing and then runs serena with the IF-14 §4 arguments, stdio passed through), so the config always exists before Serena starts.
defects.resolution: REQ-1013 revised (G2/G3 2026-10-13); Serena started through sdd serena-launch (91f7bcf); TS-1015 passes

defects.summary: Found in C002-T-056 X3 (observations, not blocking): (1) after a one-line Revise at G2 the conductor runs spec-writer, auditor, a full critic re-review, an options analysis and a second interview round before showing the gate again — the rework does not fit 0.50/1.00/2.00 USD on OpenCode; consider a proportionate rework path in the gate-protocol / revise skills; (2) a capped session with a running subagent leaves the conductor's step without a cost, so most such sessions read spend partial and block their pool until reconciled by hand — consider reconciling automatically from OpenRouter's key usage delta.
